industrySolutions.title: IT & Technology Recruitment
industrySolutions.tagline: Find and verify tech talent in a competitive market.
industrySolutions.body: Skills change quickly and the best developers get several offers. Identify strong candidates early, test what they can actually do, and move before competitors do.
points: AI sourcing for developers, engineers, data and DevOps roles
Technical assessments and live coding interviews
Skill extraction that reads beyond job titles and tech buzzwords
Fast scheduling to keep in-demand candidates engaged

industrySolutions.title: Healthcare Recruitment
industrySolutions.tagline: Hire qualified healthcare professionals, without the paperwork delay.
industrySolutions.body: Hospitals and clinics need qualified, credentialed staff, often urgently. Screen faster and keep a ready pipeline for critical roles.
points: Talent pools for doctors, nurses, technicians and support staff
Capture of qualifications, licenses and certifications in candidate profiles
Shift, location and availability-based matching
Automated follow-ups and document collection before joining

industrySolutions.title: BFSI Recruitment
industrySolutions.tagline: Hire trusted talent for banking, finance and insurance.
industrySolutions.body: BFSI hiring demands accuracy, integrity and attention to regulation. Screen consistently, keep clear records, and handle high volumes for branch and sales roles.
points: Screening for relationship managers, analysts, sales and operations roles
Aptitude and behavioral assessments for customer-facing positions
Audit trails and approval workflows for every hiring decision
Secure handling of candidate data

industrySolutions.title: Manufacturing Recruitment
industrySolutions.tagline: Fill plant, floor and technical roles at scale.
industrySolutions.body: Manufacturing needs both skilled technicians and large numbers of operators, often across multiple locations. Keep production moving with a steady pipeline.
points: Bulk hiring for operators, supervisors and technicians
Skill and certification tracking, such as ITI and diploma holders
Mobile-friendly applications and WhatsApp updates for floor-level candidates
Location-wise pipelines and reporting across plants
industrySolutions.statLabel: hires processed in a single quarter

industrySolutions.title: Retail Recruitment
industrySolutions.tagline: Hire quickly for stores, seasons and fast-growing chains.
industrySolutions.body: Retail hiring is high-volume, high-turnover and often seasonal. Cut the time between application and joining so stores are never short-staffed.
points: Quick application and automated screening for store roles
Chatbot and WhatsApp engagement for entry-level candidates
Self-service interview scheduling by store and shift
Talent pools of past applicants for peak season hiring

industrySolutions.title: BPO & Contact Centers
industrySolutions.tagline: Hire hundreds of agents, without hiring hundreds of recruiters.
industrySolutions.body: Contact centers need large volumes of people with strong communication skills, fast. Automate the first rounds and let recruiters focus on final selection.
points: Voice-based AI interviews to assess spoken communication
Aptitude, typing and language assessments
Bulk screening, ranking and shortlisting
Automated scheduling, reminders and joining follow-ups

sizeSolutions.title: Startups
sizeSolutions.tagline: Hire like a big team, even if you’re a small one.
sizeSolutions.profile: First hires, no dedicated recruiting team yet
sizeSolutions.body: When every hire matters and there’s no dedicated recruiter, speed and simplicity are everything. Automate the repetitive work and spend your time talking to the best candidates.
points: Quick setup with no complicated training
AI sourcing and screening to replace manual resume sorting
Automated interviews and scheduling for founders and hiring managers
Affordable, flexible plans that grow with your team

sizeSolutions.title: Mid-Market
sizeSolutions.tagline: Scale your hiring without scaling your recruiting team.
sizeSolutions.profile: Growing across multiple roles and teams at once
sizeSolutions.body: Growing companies often hire across multiple roles and teams at once, with processes that start to break. Bring structure and visibility to hiring before it becomes a bottleneck.
points: A single workspace for recruiters and hiring managers
Structured pipelines, scorecards and approval workflows
Analytics to track time-to-hire and source performance
Integrations with the tools your team already uses

sizeSolutions.title: Large Enterprises
sizeSolutions.tagline: Consistent, controlled hiring across every team and location.
sizeSolutions.profile: Many business units, high volumes, strict governance
sizeSolutions.body: Enterprises need to manage high volumes, many stakeholders and strict internal processes. Standardize how your teams hire while giving each department the flexibility it needs.
points: Bulk hiring with automated screening, assessments and interviews
Role-based access and customizable approval chains
Audit trails and reporting for leadership and compliance teams
Dedicated onboarding and support for large rollouts

sizeSolutions.title: Global Organizations
sizeSolutions.tagline: Hire across borders with one connected platform.
sizeSolutions.profile: Hiring across countries, multiple languages and regulations
sizeSolutions.body: Hiring in multiple countries brings different languages, regulations and time zones. Keep a single view of talent worldwide while respecting local requirements.
points: Centralized talent pools and reporting across regions
Candidate engagement across email, chat and WhatsApp
Privacy and data protection controls to support regional regulations
Asynchronous interviews that work across time zones

useCaseSolutions.title: High Volume Hiring
useCaseSolutions.tagline: Hire hundreds, without hiring hundreds of recruiters.
useCaseSolutions.body: When thousands apply for the same roles, manual screening can’t keep up. Automate the early stages and let your team focus on the final selection.
points: Bulk resume parsing, screening and ranking
Automated assessments and AI interviews
Chatbot, WhatsApp and email engagement to keep candidates moving
Self-service interview scheduling for large batches

useCaseSolutions.title: Campus Hiring
useCaseSolutions.tagline: Run campus drives faster and smarter.
useCaseSolutions.body: Evaluate large groups of freshers fairly, even when resumes look alike. Use tests and interviews to find potential, not just marks.
points: Aptitude, cognitive and technical assessments for fresher screening
Bulk registration, shortlisting and result sharing
Proctored online tests for fair evaluation
Talent pools of campus candidates for future hiring

useCaseSolutions.title: Executive Hiring
useCaseSolutions.tagline: Discreet, structured hiring for senior leadership roles.
useCaseSolutions.body: Senior hires need a careful, confidential and well-documented process. Keep stakeholders aligned and decisions evidence-based.
points: Targeted sourcing and talent pools for leadership roles
Restricted access to keep searches confidential
Panel interview coordination with structured scorecards
Approval workflows and audit trails for final decisions

useCaseSolutions.title: Contract Staffing
useCaseSolutions.tagline: Fill temporary and project roles in days, not weeks.
useCaseSolutions.body: Contract hiring is about speed and flexibility. Reuse your talent pools to find available, pre-vetted people when a project starts.
points: Search past candidates by skill, availability and location
Quick screening and shortlisting for short-term needs
Fast offer generation and e-signature
Pre-onboarding checklists to get contractors started quickly

useCaseSolutions.title: Internal Mobility
useCaseSolutions.tagline: Find your next great hire inside your own company.
useCaseSolutions.body: Your best candidate may already work for you. Match employees to open roles based on their skills and growth, and retain talent while saving on hiring costs.
points: Skill-based matching of employees to internal openings
Internal talent pools by skill, experience and interest
Consistent assessment and approval processes
Reporting on internal moves and fill rates

useCaseSolutions.title: Recruitment Agencies
useCaseSolutions.tagline: Fill more client roles with the same team.
useCaseSolutions.body: Agencies juggle multiple clients, roles and deadlines. Source faster, submit better-matched candidates and keep every client organized.
points: Resume database search and AI sourcing across client requirements
Separate pipelines and workspaces per client
Shareable shortlists and candidate profiles for client review
Analytics on recruiter productivity and placements
